hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn Uniswap v4 hook that absorbs main-token sells from an on-hook pot at the pool's own execution price (shield), and buys back the main token on detected buy swaps up to a sandwich-proof fee cap (pump). Optionally supports auto-compounding concentrated-liquidity LP fee programs with configurable split allocations.
